settings.content: The official VELREYA fragrances. One per line: handle | Name | Tagline | Character | Accent color | Atmosphere color | Top notes | Heart notes | Base notes. The handle must match the product handle in Shopify (for example nova → /products/nova). Prices, stock and 12ml variants always come from the Shopify product; product metafields override these notes if set.
